notes: New: Listen has a Reciter choice: Yasser Al-Dossary (default), Yasser Salamah, Mishary Alafasy or Fares Abbad.
Fix: the high-pitched ticking heard in some of Yasser Al-Dossary's audio files (Taha 47-135 and others) is filtered out.
New: About > Updates can follow Beta versions (every update); unticked, Meddeb offers only the stable versions.
New: press the microphone while the speech model is still loading: Meddeb listens at once and catches up once ready.
Change: updates download much less, and the speech model and reciters' audio are kept in Android's cache.
Change: Review: a failed card comes back after 45 min; cards on neighbouring ayat are one card; new button order.
New: Listen shows how long the range plays; pause between plays 6 s, a 3 s fade-out; Review's play follows Repeat.
Change: the alarm threshold is a slider with precision and recall; Optimize sits under the speech model.
Change: the bar reads search, microphone, next ayah, next word; hint buttons turn pale green when a press counts as read.
Change: wider messages with an X; Blind's empty ayah sign; Stats and Progress reordered; Al-Fatiha leaves the Manzil.
Change: Listen moved into Recite: the speaker button next to the microphone opens a panel to pick a range and play it.
Change: a Review card ends by itself once its last word is read, and says when it comes back (in 5 days, in 40 min).
New: Settings > Review > Cards a day (15 by default); cards now also cover the page you are learning and small gaps.
New: tap an ayah's number to underline the last words that tell which ayah comes next.
Change: a long press on a word adds or removes an insertion mark before it, with a short buzz; sliding no longer does.
New: going back a page lands at its end; a strip shows the next page's first words, and pulling up turns the page.
Fix: two words said in swapped order are a mistake; Meddeb learns from your corrections to raise fewer false alarms.
Fix: Yasser's ayat that he joins without a pause now play from his clean recording instead of staying text only.
Change: "Manzil" is now "Oldest page"; once you know more than 10 pages, Al-Fatiha's page always counts as today.
Fix: after an undo the word shows red; Help fits a phone screen; keyboard hints only with a keyboard; a fresh install explains itself.
